name: loongs/saas
description: loong-swoole multi-tenancy (SaaS) on top of loongs/orm — coroutine-local tenant scopes, tenant registry / resolvers, one bounded connection pool per tenant; calls without a tenant keep using the framework / ORM pools

suggest.ext-swoole: Coroutine-local tenant scopes (Tenancy::run / Tenancy::go) and waiting for a free pooled connection
suggest.loongs/framework: Calls without a tenant use the framework's PDOPool (db()); tenant pool settings from config('database.tenant_pool')

scripts.test: php -d disable_functions= tests/saas_test.php cli && php -d disable_functions= tests/saas_test.php co
